scope: The main menu puts its apps in groups.

topics.title: Office tools
details: The main menu is shorter. Its apps are now in groups.
Office tools has your apps for mail, notes, and files.
It has Word processor and Document reader.
You will find Calendar and Contacts there, and File manager too.
Say "Office tools", or press Enter on it.

topics.title: Shut down or restart
details: Shut down the computer and Restart the computer are now in Shut down or restart.
Each one still asks you first.

topics.title: Going back
details: When you leave an app you opened from Office tools, you go back to Office tools. You land on the app you left.
Escape on Office tools goes to the main menu. "Main menu" and Control+F1 always go straight there.
You can still open any app by name. For example, say "Email" or "File manager" on the main menu.
